llm_fields.description: The scheme provides a cash incentive of ₹2,00,000 to couples belonging to the Scheduled Tribe community who marry across different sub‑castes, provided the marriage occurs on or after 1 April 2018 and the couple resides in Karnataka.
llm_fields.eligibility: Both partners must reside in Karnataka, belong to the Scheduled Tribe community but be from different sub‑castes, have a combined annual income less than ₹2,00,000, and apply within one year of a marriage that took place on or after 1 April 2018.
